portInfo.description: Cruise calls for the Perth market dock at Fremantle, not in Perth CBD. Fremantle Ports’ facilities page (archived 2025 after a live 403) places the Fremantle Passenger Terminal on F and G berths at Victoria Quay, with two berths, 11 m design depth, 204/206 m maximum lengths and a 40,000-tonne displacement note requiring Harbour Master approval above that figure. The cruise page (archived 2024) states visiting cruise ships berth at the Passenger Terminal or at D Berth, and describes a free shuttle to Fremantle Train Station on ship days. Treat archive captures as provisional until the live site is re-readable.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Fremantle West End / markets — short walk from Victoria Quay.
Perth CBD — train from Fremantle Station; allow round-trip buffer.
Rottnest Island — ferry day; only with long call + confirmed last ferry.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: SeaDays slug says Perth, but you land in Fremantle — budget train time if your plan is the CBD.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Fremantle Passenger Terminal — Victoria Quay, Fremantle WA, Australia
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Archive: ~1 km to Fremantle centre; free ship-day shuttle to train station ~every 20 minutes; taxis/rideshare at Peter Hughes Drive; pedestrian bridge to station noted as no longer accessible. Perth Airport transfers exist via shuttle companies — prices null.
